title: The stale-stop remedy for a landing refused at stale says to edit the branch, but a git commit --amend there drops the KB-Work trailer, which only the item's own commands add back
goal: the land stale-stop recipe in backlog.md says that an amend of the worker's commit to add a Self-Reviewed name keeps the KB-Work trailer in the message, since the commit hook adds only the KB-Operator and the later trailers

run: import sys;t=open("kb/_self/backlog.md",encoding="utf-8").read();sys.exit(0 if "amend" in t and "KB-Work" in t[t.find("amend"):t.find("amend")+400] else 1)
